memory_candidates.content: When threading a new flag through workflow commands: (1) commands that do inline flag parsing (research.md, plan.md) need a new numbered item in STAGE 1.5 plus the flag added to the focus_prompt strip list; (2) commands that delegate to parse-command-args.sh (implement.md, orchestrate.md) only need the export comment and skill args updated; (3) always sync extension core copies in .claude/extensions/core/commands/ immediately after editing; (4) use lowercase var names in inline-parsing commands and uppercase in parse-command-args.sh commands, but keep skill args lowercase (lit_flag={LIT_FLAG} pattern).
